zh-CN.music.off: 默认关闭。主动播放后可在站内连续收听；刷新页面后需重新播放。
zh-CN.music.exporting: 正在生成配乐视频，网站音乐已暂停。
zh-CN.music.busy: 视频正在生成，请完成或取消后再播放音乐。
zh-CN.music.unsupported: 此浏览器不支持本地音乐播放。
zh-CN.music.blocked: 播放未获浏览器允许，请重新点击播放。
zh-CN.music.loadError: 音乐加载失败，可重试；网站其他功能仍可使用。
zh-CN.music.badTrack: 曲目不可用，请重新选择。
zh-CN.music.interrupted: 音频已中断，请重新点击播放。
zh-CN.music.exportHint: 地图播放与视频导出使用此配乐；导出会写入所选音轨。与网站音乐互斥。
zh-CN.music.zero: 音量为 0，本次按无配乐导出。
zh-CN.music.noAudioSupport: 此浏览器不支持配乐，可继续无配乐导出。
zh-CN.music.noRecordingSupport: 此浏览器不能录制带配乐文件，请选“无配乐”或使用新版 Chrome / Edge。
zh-CN.music.customMissing: 请重新选择本地音频文件。
zh-CN.music.fileHint: 仅在本机使用，不上传。WAV / MP3 / M4A / AAC / OGG / FLAC / WebM，最大 10 MB、5 分钟；短音频会循环。请使用你有权使用的音乐。
zh-CN.music.fileSize: 请选择非空且不超过 10 MB 的音频。
zh-CN.music.fileType: 不支持此文件格式，请选择音频文件。
zh-CN.music.fileDuration: 音频时长须为 0.5 秒至 5 分钟。
zh-CN.music.fileDecode: 无法读取该音频，可能是格式不兼容或文件损坏。
zh-CN.music.fileReady: 已选本地音频：{name}（{seconds} 秒）。刷新后需重新选择。
zh-CN.video.zeroExport: 配乐音量为 0。请调高音量，或明确选择“无配乐”。
zh-CN.video.silentSource: 所选音频没有可检测的声音，请换一首音乐或选择无配乐。
zh-CN.video.missingAudio: 未能验证有效配乐，未提供无声成品。请重新生成，或明确选择无配乐。
zh-CN.video.unexpectedAudio: 无配乐模式出现意外音轨，未提供文件，请重试。
zh-CN.video.estimate: {mode}：{count}/{total} 站，预计 {duration}。实时录制，生成耗时接近片长；概览保留起终点并节选站点，片尾展示完整轨迹。
zh-CN.video.formatUnsupported: 此浏览器不支持所选格式。建议使用新版 Chrome / Edge 导出 MP4，或主动选择 WebM 备用格式。
zh-CN.video.mp4Help: 推荐 MP4（H.264；有配乐时为 AAC）。微信请按相册视频发送；作为文件发送可能仍显示附件，预览支持以客户端为准。
zh-CN.video.webmHelp: WebM 是备用格式，部分聊天软件和播放器不能直接预览。需要分享时建议改用支持 MP4 的浏览器。
zh-CN.video.notCompatible: 输出未通过 H.264/AAC 兼容检查，未提供文件。请使用新版 Chrome / Edge 重试。

zh-CN.common.entry.makerNote: 记录自己的停留，导入文档，制作图片或视频。草稿只在你的浏览器本地处理。

en.music.off: Off by default. After you press Play, music continues within the site. Play again after a refresh.
en.music.exporting: Recording the soundtrack video. Site music is paused.
en.music.busy: Finish or cancel the video recording before playing music.
en.music.unsupported: This browser cannot play local music.
en.music.blocked: The browser blocked playback. Click Play again.
en.music.loadError: Music could not load. Retry; the other site features still work.
en.music.badTrack: This track is unavailable. Choose another track.
en.music.interrupted: Audio was interrupted. Click Play again.
en.music.exportHint: Used for map playback and included in video exports. Site music pauses to avoid overlapping audio.
en.music.zero: Volume is 0: this video will have no soundtrack.
en.music.noAudioSupport: Soundtracks are unavailable in this browser. You can still export without music.
en.music.noRecordingSupport: This browser cannot record a soundtrack. Choose None or use a current Chrome / Edge.
en.music.customMissing: Please select the local audio file again.
en.music.fileHint: Stays on this device; never uploaded. WAV / MP3 / M4A / AAC / OGG / FLAC / WebM, up to 10 MB and 5 minutes. Short tracks loop. Use music you have permission to use.
en.music.fileSize: Choose a non-empty audio file up to 10 MB.
en.music.fileType: Unsupported file format. Choose an audio file.
en.music.fileDuration: Audio must be between 0.5 seconds and 5 minutes.
en.music.fileDecode: Cannot read this audio. The format may be unsupported or the file damaged.
en.music.fileReady: Selected: {name} ({seconds} seconds). Select it again after a refresh.
en.video.zeroExport: Soundtrack volume is 0. Increase it or explicitly choose None.
en.video.silentSource: No audible signal was found in this audio. Choose another track or None.
en.video.missingAudio: A valid soundtrack could not be verified. No silent result was offered. Retry or explicitly choose None.
en.video.unexpectedAudio: An unexpected audio track was found in None mode. No file was offered. Retry.
en.video.estimate: {mode}: {count}/{total} stops, about {duration}. Recording takes roughly the video length. The overview selects stops and retains both endpoints; the ending shows the complete trail.
en.video.formatUnsupported: This browser cannot record the selected format. Use a current Chrome / Edge for MP4, or explicitly choose WebM.
en.video.mp4Help: Recommended: MP4 with H.264 and AAC when music is selected. Send it as a gallery video in WeChat; sending a file may still create an attachment. Preview support depends on the client.
en.video.webmHelp: WebM is an alternative. Some chat apps and players cannot preview it directly. For sharing, use a browser that supports MP4.
en.video.notCompatible: The output did not pass the H.264/AAC check. No file was offered. Retry in a current Chrome / Edge.
